description: PAID, from ten cents in USDC by x402; the first reply is the price and nothing is charged until the AI agent signs a payment. Proof of a venue's measured atmosphere: the venue-level averages (energy, loudness, tempo, acousticness, danceability and the rest) recomputed from the audio features of every track in its published playlist, each track's record checked against its hash, the published record exactly as it was read with its SHA-256, and a receipt of this check anchored in Bitcoin and bound to the payment. For an AI agent that books, places or reports on a venue by its atmosphere and must later show what it checked. The venue's record itself is free to read at its profile_url + '.jsonld'. Not a search: find_venues finds places, free.

declaredValueUsd.description: The stakes in US dollars the AI agent is acting on, such as the value of a booking or a placement. They set the price band (ten cents under $100, one dollar from $100, ten dollars from $10,000); undeclared stakes are priced at ten cents. The declared figure is part of the call that the receipt anchors in Bitcoin, so the receipt shows it. No money other than the price moves.

purpose.description: Optional: what the AI agent is about to do, in its own words, such as booking the venue for an event. Bound into the anchored receipt as part of the call.

reference.description: Optional: the AI agent's own reference for the action, such as a booking id or sha256:<hash> of its document. Bound into the anchored receipt as part of the call.

slug.description: The venue's slug, as find_venues and get_venue return it (the last part of its profile_url).

slugs.description: Several venues in one call, in place of slug: one payment and one receipt for all of them.

name: verify_venue
title: Verify a venue's measured atmosphere, with a Bitcoin receipt
